description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter app, including the main scaffold with bottom navigation, tabs (Home, Search, Favorites), and logic for fetching and displaying recipes, as well as handling user interactions such as logout and navigation to recipe details.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the home screen with bottom navigation, including tabs for Home, Search, and Favorites.

classes.name: _HomeTab
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the content of the Home tab, which displays recipes fetched from RecipeProvider and allows navigation to detail screens.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and prefetches recipes when the HomeScreen widget is created.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including app bar, body content, and bottom navigation.

methods.name: _openRecipe
methods.description: Navigates to the recipe detail screen with the given recipe ID.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the content of the _HomeTab widget, including loading state, error handling, and a grid of recipe cards.
